about: u1 is an edit a comment asked for (idea-mara's step count); u2 migrates the swim line to idea-tobias with two [AGENT] lines nobody asked for. The real Edit guard raises writer-line-edited on b1-u1 and agent-line-added twice on b1-u2. b1-u1 is approved and a comment started it, so f1 stands and skips the flags call. f2 and f3 are on a unit its tag started, so `act` at pointed sends them to the migration-verifier: verify-flags.json holds f2, f3, and the cut-down b1-u2, not f1 or b1-u1; the step is judging and no note changed. The saved flag findings say f2 and f3 were not asked for. `findings` moves to judged. `act` leaves u1's edit standing and undoes b1-u2 once: its three copy lines leave idea-tobias, and its pointer comes off the swim line. The step is acted, next_check 2. The second check (with --judged flags-1.json --findings findings-flags.json) drops f1, which stood, the way it drops a flag judged asked for, and comes back [].

edited is false at judging when `act` at pointed changed nothing, and becomes true at the second `act`.

Revised 2026-10-23 for Run manager Milestone 16 (spec-migration-verifier.md 06 item 7; spec-run-manager.md 05 item 8 and 11 item 101): f1 (writer-line-edited on b1-u1, trigger kind `comment`) now stands instead of going to the call. verify-flags.json and the saved findings lose f1; every other expected file is unchanged, since a flag that stood leaves the change as a flag judged asked for did. The reading 'An edit unit judged asked for stays approved' now applies to an edit unit whose flag stood.
